question: Across the full 100-seed m048 cohort under post-fix truth, which candidate cost surfaces are defined and small when evaluated at (q0_truth, omega_truth)?
hypothesis: A viable inversion cost surface should place truth at a small, near-argmin value on every seed.
narrative_md: Cohort-scale cost-at-truth survey (post-fix, 100 m048 seeds): surrogate full-LC MSE is the only cost surface defined and small on all 100 seeds (median 3.0e-4 mag^2, max ratio rho-equiv 1.20 -- all Band A). m103 alignment cost is structurally undefined on 24/100 seeds (<=1 spec peak) and lofi peak-match is universal-but-broken on 2 seeds (3, 10). Diagnostic: scores cost AT truth, so reads truth as input (oracle-leak).
